extraction.Name: John Cordier
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged and then sold it
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent delivered in 1918 from Mr. Kephart, the farmer at Black Pipe; mortgaged for $300 and sold for $2600 (payment for sale not all made at one time); wife and four children depend on him for support; in good health; did ask for patent; notarized June 4, 1929 by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32
